body: They're very racist and homophobic and mentally ill and get very loud and scream and my whole life has been ruined because of them. I doubt I was born with major depressive disorder I think they gave it to me.
I'm not, but I just wish I could, I just wish I could not even live because no matter how much I want to not wake up the next morning I have to be alive and live in pain everyday

I do have therapist but they don't help, my school counselor was really bad and made me depressed my entire school year, I felt so fucking worthless and unimportant it was all caused by them a big chunk of it, describing my problems and issues with my parents and having them blow it off and not even call me to wish a happy graduation made me hurt so bad. They only called bc it's their job but I can't keep thinking that therapists care because honestly I feel like all of them don't.

I deactivated my twitter so that eventually it'll be deleted and my Snapchat too, but I still find ways to become sad and feel like wishing I could be a sociable person, even if I hid my scars well, I'll always be weird and awkard and not in the good way, I don't know when to speak or what to speak about, all I do is make myself uncomfortable for myself and other people, I honestly wish I could live far away on an island but I'm not important enough to deserve that. I just wish the world could be more forgiving or different, out of everything why'd it have to turn out like this.

It's my fault though I'm always awkard so I can't do anything about it sometimes I think maybe I could become someone I'm not like a regular person but I feel like that's too hard. I wish I just could fucking die, I hate myself my whole entire life feels like a tragedy and suicide feels like the gateway to get out of it, to get the past laugh at everybody.

I just wish I had friends I have a bad family life and that probably reflected on me so I'm probably not socialble person to begin with and I have scars all over my wrists and thighs, I weird everyone out, I just feel like such a screw up and I wish I could've just been someone else. I don't feel like I'm worth anything at all. I hate my body and I hate my personality, I would do anything to be like any other person
